name: laravel
title: Laravel
conventions: Keep controllers thin and move business logic into services, actions, or domain classes.
Validate request input with form requests and authorize actions with policies or gates.
Use Eloquent relationships and query scopes instead of raw SQL unless a raw query is justified.
Write reversible migrations and never edit a migration that has already run in production.
Queue slow work and make jobs idempotent.
Format with Laravel Pint and keep configuration in config files plus environment variables.
